name: Trello
description:
The Trello MCP server lets Claude interact with your Trello boards, cards, and tasks using natural language. All communication between Claude and Trello is encrypted for privacy and authenticated using security best practices. Once configured, you can manage your to-do’s without having to switch between tabs.

You can use the Trello connector on Claude to:
• Capture and organize new ideas into an actionable plan
“Create a Trello board for the Italy travel plan we just discussed.”

• Get a clear view of what's on your plate and schedule time to get things done
“Show me any Trello cards due this week and book focus time on my calendar to get them done.”

• Enrich your Trello content without having to open the app
“Review the tasks I have on my wedding planning board and add anything missing.”

• Clean up and triage your to-do's automatically
“Move everything in my Trello Inbox onto boards.”

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trello to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trello to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trello.com/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Trello MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Trello scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trello MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trello lists 15 MCP tools, including trelloReadBoard, trelloReadCard, trelloReadChecklist, trelloReadInbox, trelloReadList, trelloReadMember, trelloReadPlanner, trelloReadWorkspace, trelloSearch, trelloWriteBoard, trelloWriteCard, and trelloWriteChecklist.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trello?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Trello in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Trello requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Trello failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trello scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Trello is developed by Trello. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
